layout.request: Mike, 0916, over three passes: "you can list 4 at once, but use square boxes plus rectangle text next to them" / "should be 4 large boxes for th weapon icons, 4 rectangle boxes next to the large boxes. re-do" / with a crop of the plate’s rank box and word strip: "I meant 4 of these like this. and stretch to fill icons inside the box"
layout.now: the row is the PLATE'S OWN box and strip, blitted four times - the RANK bay (0.5220,0.6466,0.1111,0.1579) and its word strip (0.6667,0.6880,0.2453,0.0677) cut out of statpanel_full_0916 and repeated, named in UNLOCK_ART so the rows and the debrief cannot disagree about where the art is
layout.slicing: the strip is 3-sliced (6.5:1 source into a ~8:1 row would pull its rounded caps into ovals); the box keeps its source aspect 1.24 rather than being forced square
layout.icon: stretched to fill the box. iconBlit takes a HEIGHT and derives width from the art's aspect, and three art stores make that unknowable at the call site - so one draw at alpha 0 off-screen returns the width it would take and the real draw runs under a horizontal scale
layout.opacity: every socket is opaque, filled or not - missed twice (0.55, then 0.62), and both times the plate's baked thin bays read through the empty sockets as a second set of rails
cuts_rejected: borrowed the debrief stat bays (0.0526 of the plate) so the box was a text row tall
drew its own flat panels, which read as holes punched in the art beside the authored bays
layout.moved: LOOK FOR THEM IN THE FIELD to the sign-off strip, CONTINUE to the footer, because the rows cover the score bay
